statements.text: The decombination problem is the problem, for any view that starts from a conscious cosmos, of how seemingly separate lower-level subjects with private points of view form within it.

sources.quote: the ‘decombination problem’ (also called the ‘decomposition problem’ in Chalmers, 2016a): how do seemingly separate lower-level subjects — which, from now on, I shall follow Shani (2015, p. 415) in referring to as ‘relative subjects’ — form within the conscious cosmos?
